mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, initiator_id, owner_id, last_seq, last_message_at, last_message_type, last_message_preview, apply_status, apply_at, apply_decided_at, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.post_id AS post_id, c.last_message_type AS last_message_type, c.last_message_preview AS last_message_preview, c.last_message_at AS last_message_at, c.apply_status AS apply_status, peer.id AS peer_id, peer.nickname AS peer_nickname, peer.avatar_url AS peer_avatar_url, p.title AS post_title, p.status AS post_status, (SELECT pm.object_key FROM post_media pm WHERE pm.post_id = c.post_id AND pm.audit_status = 'pass' ORDER BY pm.id LIMIT 1) AS post_thumbnail_key, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.seq > cm.last_read_seq AND (m.visible_to IS NULL OR m.visible_to = #{userId}) AND m.sender_id <> #{userId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unread_flag FROM conversation c JOIN conversation_member cm ON cm.conversation_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} JOIN user peer ON peer.id = CASE WHEN c.initiator_id = #{userId} THEN c.owner_id ELSE c.initiator_id END JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.last_message_at >= #{visibleSince} AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation c JOIN conversation_member cm ON cm.conversation_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.last_message_at >= #{visibleSince} AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL
